entries.statement: On the US 1997-2026 sample (5 real-time evaluation episodes, a persistent binary credit flag tied to price features), neither the circular-rotation null nor a model-X conditional randomization test with an estimated generator gives a valid p-value for 'credit adds information given price features': in synthetic null worlds they over-reject (rotation 21% under nonlinear misspecification; CRT 6.8-8.3% even when the generator passes label-free checks).

The PR #365 READY_FOR_STAGE_3 decision and its synthetic size/power figures are withdrawn as validity evidence: they were measured in worlds where the credit flag was independent of the price features.

The real WIDEN_3M_ABOVE_EXPANDING_P80 flag correlates with gap200 (-0.39) and vol63 (+0.50); it is on in 9.4% of FAST-normal months and 41-51% of stressed months. A linear logistic generator with two flag lags reproduces 22 label-free path statistics.

hypothesesToConfirmIndependently.status: NOT_READY_FOR_INFERENTIAL_STAGE_3; PROSPECTIVE_PENDING; a historical descriptive M1/M2 comparison would need a separate owner decision and is not evidence of conditional independence
